entry_route.value: A master's is the usual route, but students with only a bachelor's can enter directly if exceptional.
entry_route.quote: Direct entry to the Ph.D. in Zoology program for students with only a bachelor's degree, or accelerated entry from the M.S. in Zoology program, is possible for students demonstrating exceptional potential

notes: This is the Zoology PhD. The same school also offers a Ph.D. in Plant Biology (https://gradcatalog.siu.edu/programs/plb/), which the catalog does not give a GRE, deadline or entry rule for, so this record covers Zoology only. Zoology requires a 3.25 graduate GPA.
